question: Which gas is also known as the laughing gas?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nitrous Oxide.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nitrous Oxide** is also called **laughing gas** or** happy gas** due to its intoxicating effects when inhaled.
 
• It was initially discovered around **1772** by the English scientist and **Clergyman Joseph Priestley.**
 
• It is a** colorless**,** non-flammable** gas.
 
• This gas is used in medical and dental procedures as a **sedative.**
 
• It helps to relieve anxiety before the procedure and allows the patient to relax.
 
• Nitrous oxide is routinely used alongside other anesthetic agents in operating rooms everywhere.
 
• It’s also used as a mild sedative and analgesic during childbirth, for emergency medical care and for dental procedures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Nitrous oxide is a **depressant,** so it slows your body down. 
 
• Once it kicks in, you may feel happy, giggly, light-headed, mild-euphoria, relaxed.
 
• Nitrous oxide gets the name** “laughing gas”** because of these effects. 
 
• Some people may also experience mild hallucinations while under the use of laughing gas.
 
• Physically, you might feel like your arms and legs are heavy.
 
• You may also experience a tingling sensation in your limbs.
